tools.name: maritime-intelligence_vessel-identity-normalize
tools.description: Normalize caller-supplied vessel name, IMO, MMSI, call sign, flag, owner, and operator fields. Validates IMO checksum when an IMO is supplied. Paid AIS coverage is not used. Price $0.03 USDC. POST /api/v1/maritime-intelligence/vessel-identity-normalize. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms

tools.name: maritime-intelligence_ais-track-gap-detect
tools.description: Detect time gaps and implied speeds between caller-supplied AIS points. Global real-time AIS coverage is not claimed. Price $0.04 USDC. POST /api/v1/maritime-intelligence/ais-track-gap-detect. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: maritime-intelligence_vessel-route-deviation-detect
tools.description: Compare caller-supplied AIS points to planned waypoints and flag points beyond a distance threshold. Price $0.04 USDC. POST /api/v1/maritime-intelligence/vessel-route-deviation-detect. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: maritime-intelligence_port-congestion-analyze
tools.description: Analyze caller-supplied port wait, queue, and berth-occupancy samples. Live terminal systems are not queried. Price $0.04 USDC. POST /api/v1/maritime-intelligence/port-congestion-analyze. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: maritime-intelligence_vessel-eta-estimate
tools.description: Estimate ETA from the latest caller-supplied AIS point to a destination using geodesic distance and SOG or assumed speed. Price $0.04 USDC. POST /api/v1/maritime-intelligence/vessel-eta-estimate. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: maritime-intelligence_demurrage-cost-calculate
tools.description: Calculate demurrage from caller-supplied allowed/used laytime and daily rate. Results are not legal invoices. Price $0.03 USDC. POST /api/v1/maritime-intelligence/demurrage-cost-calculate. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: maritime-intelligence_vessel-sanctions-signal-check
tools.description: Screen caller-supplied vessel/owner/operator names and IMOs against caller sanctions entries or optional key-free OFAC SDN names. Not a legal determination. Price $0.05 USDC. POST /api/v1/maritime-intelligence/vessel-sanctions-signal-check. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not

tools.name: maritime-intelligence_cargo-shipment-event-reconcile
tools.description: Reconcile document-side and ops-side caller-supplied cargo shipment events by shipment/BL, event type, time, location, and quantity. Price $0.04 USDC. POST /api/v1/maritime-intelligence/cargo-shipment-event-reconcile. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: maritime-intelligence_vessel-ownership-history-normalize
tools.description: Normalize caller-supplied vessel ownership timeline rows and flag overlapping intervals. Registry filings are not invented. Price $0.03 USDC. POST /api/v1/maritime-intelligence/vessel-ownership-history-normalize. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "maritime-intelligence" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: maritime-intelligence_vessel-sanctions-signal-check · Private data: maritime-intelligence_cargo-shipment-event-reconcile, maritime-intelligence_voyage-risk-report · Public sink: maritime-intelligence_vessel-identity-normalize, maritime-intelligence_ais-track-gap-detect, maritime-intelligence_vessel-route-deviation-detect, maritime-intelligence_port-congestion-analyze, maritime-intelligence_vessel-eta-estimate, maritime-intelligence_demurrage-cost-calculate, maritime-intelligence_vessel-sanctions-signal-check, maritime-intelligence_cargo-shipment-event-reconcile, maritime-intelligence_vessel-ownership-history-normalize, maritime-intelligence_voyage-risk-report · Destructive: maritime-intelligence_vessel-identity-normalize, maritime-intelligence_ais-track-gap-detect, maritime-intelligence_vessel-route-deviation-detect, maritime-intelligence_port-congestion-analyze, maritime-intelligence_vessel-eta-estimate, maritime-intelligence_demurrage-cost-calculate, maritime-intelligence_vessel-sanctions-signal-check, maritime-intelligence_cargo-shipment-event-reconcile, maritime-intelligence_vessel-ownership-history-normalize, maritime-intelligence_voyage-risk-report.

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
